input_boundary: Each model receives text only; C2 additionally scores every fixed class definition. Evaluation role/required/critical/Gold metadata never enters model input.

common_training.selection_partition_access: inference only after all checkpoint/policy locks; never tune from selection
common_training.checkpoint_selection: lowest validation cross-entropy among fixed epochs; ties use earlier epoch

candidates.score: entailment probability for every frozen class-definition pair, then normalize across all classes; entailment label mapping must be resolved from exact config before selection; no manual ambiguous mapping fallback

C0.mode: historical reference only; no historical labels as training targets or joint judge revival

atomicity.ATOMIC: The text contains at most one material proposition independently assessable under one grounding policy.
atomicity.NON_ATOMIC: The text combines two or more material propositions whose grounding verdicts can differ, or mixes grounding policies.
atomicity.AMBIGUOUS: The boundary between one and multiple material propositions is genuinely unresolved from this text.

content_type.SOURCE_FACT_CONTENT: The text asserts factual content about the source world, regardless of whether it is true or supported.
content_type.INTERPRETATION_CONTENT: The text states an inferential, comparative or evaluative conclusion without restating factual premises.
content_type.CREATIVE_CONTENT: The text explicitly proposes newly invented fictional material rather than asserting source-world knowledge.
content_type.CONTEXT_LIMIT_CONTENT: The text states only what the supplied context or evidence does not establish or make available.
content_type.MIXED_CONTENT: The text combines material from two or more of factual assertion, interpretation, invention or context availability.
content_type.AMBIGUOUS: The semantic content type cannot be determined safely from the text alone.

abstention.rule: Return AMBIGUOUS if top probability below confidence or top1-top2 below margin; otherwise top class.
abstention.freeze_scope: all candidate/task checkpoints and policies before first selection inference

selection.hard_gates: zero critical false-pass, zero required-valid false-reject, exact labels across 3 repeats for required/critical rows
selection.partial_task_pass: record independent task winners; no full-pair PASS unless both tasks pass; missing task retains no-selection/block
selection.confirmation: not started; do not provide any development command that loads the historical final-confirmation corpus

runtime_isolation.missing_revision_or_license_metadata: remain preparation-blocked; do not invent identity
runtime_isolation.incompatible_candidate: record reason, retain frozen pool; no replacement model

development_quality_limitations: Synthetic design-family labels are not independently human-adjudicated.
Neutral lexical banks and construction families are held out jointly; corpus size alone is not proof of real-data coverage.
